To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) it is possible to improve adversarial robust-accuracy by incorporating data generated by a generative model, (2) the improvement can be significant, and (3) the improvement is not due to overfitting.

(1) we can use generative models trained on the original training dataset to generate additional data that is useful for improving adversarial robustness, and (2) the generated data need not be realistic to improve robustness, even random data (generated from Gaussian sampling) can be useful.

(1) generative models trained only on original training data can be used to improve robustness to norm-bounded adversarial attacks and (2) this improvement can be obtained without using any additional real data.
